Subject: Cutting alert noise for your engineering team

Hi [First Name],

I'm [Your Name] at [Company]. We built a log-monitoring service that flags the alerts worth looking at and quiets the rest. In our pilot, alert noise dropped by 60%, so on-call engineers got interrupted less and spent more of their time on real problems.

If your team spends a lot of time separating real issues from false alarms, it might be worth a look.
